name: shrivener
description: Hears your repos' confessions: reviews each new commit (bugs, risky changes, missing tests) and keeps the documentation in step with the code, on its own branch, in its own worktree.

repos.about: git repos to watch: space-separated paths, or a folder whose subfolders are repos (e.g. ~/workspace)

branch.about: the branch its doc fixes go on (never your main branch)

push.about: push its branch to the remote? 'no' leaves it local for you to look at
